stem.text: The graph shows the blood antibody concentration of two people.
On day 0, person G was injected with antibodies to the tetanus toxin and person H was injected with the vaccine for tetanus.

stem.alt: Graph of antibody concentration in arbitrary units against time in days, with dashed and solid curves labelled H and G, and an arrow marking time of injection at day 0.

stem.text: What could be the result if G and H were infected with the tetanus bacteria on day 20?

A.text: Tetanus antibodies would not be produced in person G.

B.text: Antibody production would peak after day 32 in person G.

C.text: Antibody concentration would stay constant in person H.

D.text: A second antibody peak would occur in person H that would be lower than the first peak.
